issues.reason: The licensed reified-state pattern types the witness with a PROPERTY ((Member sk_full_1 full)); typing it with the count noun senior_democrat puts a second senior Democrat into the KB, so 'who is the senior Democrat?' falsely binds the state witness alongside gordon.

gaps_confirmed: no reification trigger covers a NOMINAL predicate's PP complement ('is the senior Democrat on the Subcommittee') - the enumerated triggers are resultative, connective endpoint, time modifier, an adjective's PP complement and a focus particle
new_gaps: a DEFINITE predicate nominal ('X is THE senior Democrat on Y') asserts a unique role-holder, and no licensed carrier records the uniqueness - only bare class membership survives, so a second senior Democrat could be added with no conflict
repair_summary: Dropped the reified state entirely - its class atom (the confirmed falsehood) and the now-orphaned (Experiencer sk_senior_democrat_1 gordon), since an untyped referent symbol must never appear. Re-homed the PP onto the subject as the entity-attached surface preposition (On gordon house_subcommittee_on_space_and_aeronautics), which is the word actually used and is exactly what 'Gordon is on the subcommittee' states.
notes: Everything else is left as the parser had it and is correct: senior_democrat fused as a role title with both the head genus and the gradable-modifier genus, the multi-word name kept as one opaque symbol with its lowercase particles, and its kind read off the name's own head noun.
